Name: Stylist
Description: Gear manager that will watch your gearset for possible upgrades and upgrade them via single command.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source 5f7c05cd5493ae6ea3950ddf90866512665aa085. Fixes storage sorting evicting gear used by other saved sets when dye, materia or glamour details are stale: every existing saved-set item ID is protected, and matching items in inventory return to the armory chest. Uses the original Stylist emblem recoloured in the fork-family green-to-magenta palette. Build, storage, merge-policy and package checks passed. Existing IPC identity is preserved. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.
